text_normalization.location: client preprocessing, excluded from engine timings

method.transport: loopback HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, one connection per worker process
method.load: closed-loop; fixed duration; warmed before every repetition
method.http_latency: request send through complete response read; excludes response JSON decode
method.qps: successful completions / wall time, including driver JSON decoding and result collection/drain
method.reported_search: server time field; excludes stored-document materialization/serialization
method.rss: server RSS sampled every 50 ms; includes mapped resident pages
method.quality: human qrels: nDCG@10 (linear gains), Recall@10/100, MRR@10; exact cosine Recall@K when vector mode is measured
method.scope: prepared real corpus, warm cache; operator=or; top K for timing, top 100 for relevance; embedding time excluded
method.text_normalization: identity/t2s use identical schemas: body stores the original title+text; only search_body is indexed and never returned; queries use the same transform. Normalization is precomputed; conversion time is reported separately.
